prompt: I have an Angular 21 app with multiple components that need to share a consistent color theme. I want to create a theme system using CSS custom properties that works across components with ViewEncapsulation.Emulated (the default). The theme should define primary, secondary, and surface colors, support switching between light and dark themes at runtime, and work without ::ng-deep. Show me the theme definition, how a parent component provides the theme, and how child components consume it.

assertions.name: uses_css_custom_properties
assertions.description: Uses CSS custom properties (--var-name) for theming
assertions.check: Output contains CSS custom property definitions using -- prefix and var() consumption

assertions.name: runtime_theme_switching
assertions.check: Output includes a mechanism to toggle between light and dark themes at runtime (class toggle, attribute, or signal)

assertions.name: works_with_emulated_encapsulation
assertions.description: Explicitly works with ViewEncapsulation.Emulated or default encapsulation
assertions.check: Does not require ViewEncapsulation.None or ShadowDom for the theming to work

assertions.name: child_component_consumption
assertions.description: Shows child components consuming theme variables
assertions.check: At least one child component uses var(--custom-prop) in its styles
